sop_modules.name: Floor Protection Inspection
sop_modules.description: Inspect previously installed floor covering for defects and integrity. Verify floor protection is adequate for wall finish application.

tasks.name: Inspect Floor Protection
tasks.description: Walk and inspect floor protection covering installed during earlier phases. Check for tears, lifted edges, exposed areas. Repair as needed. If no floor covering exists (subfloor only), this task is skipped.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. Binary protection task — same execution at all tiers.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: First task in wall finish sequence. Verify protection before any wall work begins.

sop_modules.name: Trim Edge Masking
sop_modules.description: Apply masking tape to all trim edges (baseboard, door casing, window casing) before wall finish application. This spec OWNS the trim masking task — when painting finish on walls, trim is always masked.

tasks.name: Mask Baseboard Top Edge
tasks.description: Apply masking tape along top edge of baseboard to protect finished trim from wall paint. Press edge firmly for clean seal. This spec owns this task — trim package is complete and masked before wall finish.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. Binary masking task — same execution at all tiers.

quality_notes.QT4: Green edge-seal tape, damp rag seal technique
quality_notes.QT5: Green edge-seal tape, perfect seal for crisp line

tasks.name: Mask Door Casing Edges
tasks.description: Apply masking tape along door casing edges adjacent to walls. Protect finished trim from wall paint.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. Binary masking task.

tasks.name: Mask Window Casing Edges
tasks.description: Apply masking tape along window casing edges adjacent to walls. Protect finished trim from wall paint.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. Binary masking task.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Mask all trim edges before any wall painting begins. This spec owns trim masking for wall finish.

sop_modules.name: Protection Setup — Wall Finish (Spray Methods)
sop_modules.description: Set up or verify protection for wall fixtures before spray or spray+backroll application.

tasks.name: Mask Wall Fixtures
tasks.description: Mask outlets, switches, and wall-mounted fixtures with tape and paper/plastic. Verify or apply. May already be in place from prime phase.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. Binary protection task — method-dependent, not tier-dependent.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Verify fixture protection before spray application.

sop_modules.name: Wall Inspection and Touch-Up
sop_modules.description: Inspect primed wall surface for imperfections. Spackle, sand, and spot prime any defects found. Required prep before finish coat. NOT included in QT2. CONDITIONAL: If SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_PRIME performed full inspection/repair, this module may be reduced or skipped via XSPEC_WALL_REPAIR_DONE flag.

cross_spec_coordination.effect: If flag is set, reduce or eliminate first inspection round to avoid double-counting. Prime spec may have already performed comprehensive inspection/repair.

tasks.name: Inspect Primed Wall Surface
tasks.description: Walk and visually inspect primed walls with work light. Mark imperfections: nail pops, dings, scratches, missed spots, rough areas, drips from prime phase.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. QT2 skips entire inspection/repair module — economy wall work applies finish directly over prime without defect correction.

tasks.name: Inspect Primed Wall Surface (Premium)
tasks.description: Detailed inspection of primed walls using bright work light. Mark all defects including minor imperfections. QT4 requires comprehensive defect identification.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2.

quality_notes.QT4: Comprehensive inspection under bright light, mark all defects

tasks.name: Inspect Primed Wall Surface (Critical)
tasks.description: Critical wall inspection using raking light with multiple passes. Higher sheen finishes show imperfections — all defects must be identified and marked.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2.

quality_notes.QT5: Critical inspection with raking light, multiple passes. Satin/semi-gloss shows imperfections.

tasks.name: Spackle Wall Imperfections
tasks.description: Apply lightweight spackle to marked imperfections: fill nail pops, dings, scratches. Feather edges for smooth transition.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. Economy wall work skips defect repair.

quality_notes.QT3: Fill all marked defects, reasonable feathering
quality_notes.QT4: Fill all defects with careful feathering for invisible repairs

tasks.name: Spackle Wall Imperfections (Critical)
tasks.description: Critical spackle work on walls with wide feathering and multiple thin coats as needed. Slower application for satin/semi-gloss finish preparation.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2.

quality_notes.QT5: Wide feathering, multiple thin coats. Perfect surface required for satin/semi-gloss.

tasks.name: Sand Spackled Areas on Wall
tasks.description: Sand spackled areas smooth after dry. Use fine grit (150-180). Blend repairs into surrounding surface.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. No spackle applied at QT2, so no sanding needed.

quality_notes.QT3: Sand and blend, repair should not telegraph
quality_notes.QT4: Sand perfectly smooth, repair should be invisible

tasks.name: Sand Spackled Areas on Wall (Critical)
tasks.description: Critical sanding of spackled areas to perfection. Use wet sponge test for smoothness. No imperfections acceptable under satin/semi-gloss finish.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2.

quality_notes.QT5: Sand to perfection, wet sponge test. No imperfections acceptable.

tasks.name: Spot Prime Spackled Areas on Wall
tasks.description: Apply spot primer or thinned wall paint to spackled areas to seal repairs before finish coat. Prevents flashing.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. No spackle applied at QT2, so no spot priming needed.

quality_notes.QT4: Spot prime all repairs, feather edges
quality_notes.QT5: Spot prime all repairs with wide feather, may need light sand after spot prime

tasks.name: Dust Wipe Wall Surface
tasks.description: Wipe walls with damp cloth or tack cloth to remove dust before finish coat application. Required after any sanding work.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. No sanding dust at QT2.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Spackle defects → Dry → Sand spackle → Spot prime → Dust wipe. All repair work must be complete and dry before finish coat.

sop_modules.name: Wall Finish Preparation — Premium/Critical
sop_modules.description: Light sand entire primed wall surface before finish coat. QT4/QT5 only.

tasks.name: Light Sand Entire Primed Wall
tasks.description: Light sand entire primed wall surface with pole sander and 220 grit to degloss and smooth. Prepares surface for optimal finish coat adhesion.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. QT2 skips full-surface sanding.

quality_notes.QT4: Light even pass over entire wall, focus on nibs or imperfections

tasks.name: Light Sand Entire Primed Wall (Critical)
tasks.description: Thorough sanding of entire primed wall surface with raking light inspection. Critical for satin/semi-gloss finishes.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2.

quality_notes.QT5: Thorough even sanding with raking light inspection. Satin/semi-gloss shows every imperfection.

tasks.name: Vacuum Sanding Dust from Wall
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust from entire wall surface using HEPA vacuum with brush attachment or damp wipe.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. No full-surface sanding at QT2, so no dust to remove.

quality_notes.QT5: Complete vacuum of entire wall, tack cloth follow-up recommended

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Sand entire wall → Vacuum sanding dust. Performed AFTER inspection/repair module.

sop_modules.name: Cut-In at Ceiling Line
sop_modules.description: Cut-in wall paint at wall-to-ceiling boundary. WALL PAINTER ESTABLISHES THE CEILING LINE — this is the critical difference from ceiling finish. In NC production, ceiling painter rolled/sprayed freely past wall line, wall painter creates the clean line.

tasks.name: Cut-In Wall at Ceiling Line
tasks.description: Using angled brush, cut in wall paint at ceiling line. Establish clean, straight line where wall meets ceiling. This is the defining edge task for wall finish — ceiling painter did not create this line. Freehand cut-in, no tape at drywall ceiling.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. Cut-in is required at all tiers — only discipline/precision varies.

quality_notes.QT2: Acceptable if neat, minor wobble OK at distance
quality_notes.QT3: Reasonably straight line, minor wobble acceptable at distance
quality_notes.QT4: Clean line, no visible wobble at 3 feet
quality_notes.QT5: Crisp line, no visible wobble at arm's length

tasks.name: Cut-In Wall at Ceiling Line (Coat 2)
tasks.description: Cut-in ceiling line for second finish coat. Same technique as first coat.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. QT2 is single coat only.

quality_notes.QT3: Match first coat line, improve any wobbles
quality_notes.QT4: Clean line, no visible wobble at 3 feet
quality_notes.QT5: Crisp line, perfect match to first coat

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Cut-in ceiling line BEFORE field application. Field rolls/sprays into the cut-in edge.

sop_modules.name: Apply Wall Finish — Roller Method
sop_modules.description: Apply wall finish paint using roller method. Cut-in at trim edges, then roll field.

tasks.name: Cut-In Wall at Trim Edges (Coat 1)
tasks.description: Cut in wall paint at baseboard, door casing, and window casing tape lines. Cut into tape edge for clean reveal when tape is removed.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. Cut-in at trim is required at all tiers.

tasks.name: Roll Wall Finish Coat 1
tasks.description: Apply wall finish paint using 9-inch or 18-inch roller with extension pole. Work in sections, maintain wet edge. Roll into cut-in areas at ceiling and trim edges.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. QT2 is single coat. Application quality (no drips/sags/holidays) is constant across all tiers — only prep intensity varies.

quality_notes.QT2: Full coverage, minor lap marks acceptable
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform coverage, no visible lap marks — first of two coats
quality_notes.QT5: Critical application — uniform coverage, perfect technique. First of two coats.

tasks.name: Cut-In Wall at Trim Edges (Coat 2)
tasks.description: Cut in wall paint at trim edges for second coat. Same technique as first coat.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. QT2 is single coat only.

tasks.name: Roll Wall Finish Coat 2
tasks.description: Apply second wall finish coat. Same technique as first coat.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. QT2 is single coat only.

quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage, blend with first coat
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform coverage, no visible lap marks, consistent sheen

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Cut-in ceiling (separate module) → Cut-in trim → Roll field. QT2 is single coat. QT3+ is two coats default.

sop_modules.name: Apply Wall Finish — Spray + Backroll Method
sop_modules.description: Apply wall finish paint via spray followed by immediate backroll with 18-inch roller. Production standard for NC.

tasks.name: Cut-In Wall at Trim Edges (Spray Method, Coat 1)
tasks.description: Cut in wall paint at trim tape lines before spray. Provides clean edge that spray will blend into.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. Cut-in required at all tiers.

tasks.name: Spray Wall Finish Coat 1
tasks.description: Apply wall finish paint via airless sprayer. Maintain proper distance, 50% overlap, consistent speed. Backroller follows immediately.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. QT2 spray+backroll is single coat.

quality_notes.QT5: Critical spray application — perfect overlap, consistent mil thickness.

tasks.name: Backroll Wall Finish Coat 1
tasks.description: Immediately follow wall spray with 18-inch roller to consolidate paint, eliminate air pockets, and level finish. Backroller sets pace for sprayer.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. Backroll is standard for spray+backroll method.

quality_notes.QT5: Perfect backroll technique — uniform finish critical

tasks.name: Cut-In Wall at Trim Edges (Spray Method, Coat 2)
tasks.description: Cut in wall paint at trim edges for second coat.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. QT2 is single coat only.

tasks.name: Spray Wall Finish Coat 2
tasks.description: Apply second wall finish coat via airless spray.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. QT2 is single coat only.

quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage, blend with first coat

tasks.name: Backroll Wall Finish Coat 2
tasks.description: Backroll second coat immediately after spray.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. QT2 is single coat only.

quality_notes.QT5: Perfect backroll — flawless sheen uniformity required

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Cut-in ceiling (separate module) → Cut-in trim → Spray → Backroll (immediately). QT2 is single coat. QT3+ is two coats.

sop_modules.name: Apply Wall Finish — Spray Only Method
sop_modules.description: Apply wall finish paint via spray without backroll. QT2-QT3 only in controlled conditions.

tasks.name: Cut-In Wall at Trim Edges (Spray Only)
tasks.description: Cut in wall paint at trim tape lines before spray application.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2.

tasks.name: Spray Wall Finish (No Backroll)
tasks.description: Apply wall finish paint via airless sprayer. Higher overlap required when not backrolling to ensure even coverage.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. QT2 economy spray is single coat without backroll.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Cut-in ceiling (separate module) → Cut-in trim → Spray-only achieves final finish. No backroll.

sop_modules.name: Interstage Sanding — Between Finish Coats
sop_modules.description: Light sand between finish coats. QT4/QT5 only. Run rule: AFTER coat 1, BEFORE coat 2.
sop_modules.run_rule: Runs AFTER coat 1, BEFORE coat 2. For 2-coat systems, runs once.

tasks.name: Light Sand Between Finish Coats
tasks.description: Light sand first finish coat with 220 grit pole sander to smooth nibs or imperfections before second coat.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. QT2 is single coat only — no intercoat sanding.

quality_notes.QT4: Light even pass to smooth nibs before second coat

tasks.name: Light Sand Between Finish Coats (Critical)
tasks.description: Careful sanding between coats with inspection under work light. Critical for satin/semi-gloss finishes.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2.

quality_notes.QT5: Careful sanding with inspection between coats. Critical for satin/semi-gloss.

tasks.name: Vacuum Intercoat Sanding Dust
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust from walls before applying second coat.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. QT2 is single coat only — no intercoat sanding.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Light sand coat 1 → Vacuum dust → Apply coat 2. QT4/QT5 interstage work.

sop_modules.name: Cleanup — Wall Finish
sop_modules.description: Remove trim masking tape, vacuum floors, remove fixture protection, clean tools, final inspection.

tasks.name: Remove Trim Masking Tape
tasks.description: Remove masking tape from baseboard, door casing, and window casing edges. Pull at angle for clean release. This spec installed the tape, this spec removes it.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. Binary protection teardown.

tasks.name: Vacuum Floors
tasks.description: Vacuum floors to remove paint drips, overspray debris, and dust from wall painting. Uses PS_META.SF.FLOOR_VACUUM_AREA.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. Binary cleanup task — same at all tiers.

tasks.name: Remove Wall Fixture Protection
tasks.description: Remove tape and paper/plastic from outlets, switches, and wall-mounted fixtures.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. Binary protection teardown — method-dependent.

tasks.name: Clean Tools
tasks.description: Clean brushes, rollers, spray equipment with water. Store or dispose properly.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2. Binary cleanup task.

tasks.name: Final Wall Inspection
tasks.description: Walk and inspect all painted wall surfaces. Check for holidays, lap marks, coverage issues. Touch up as needed.
tasks.qt2_notes: Included at QT2 but with minimal scope. QT2 final inspection is quick visual for major misses only.

tasks.name: Final Wall Inspection (Premium)
tasks.description: Detailed inspection of all painted wall surfaces with work light. Perfect finish expected.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. Premium final inspection for QT4 only.

quality_notes.QT4: Detailed inspection with work light, perfect finish expected

tasks.name: Final Wall Inspection (Critical)
tasks.description: Critical inspection under raking light for satin/semi-gloss finish. Any imperfection must be addressed.
tasks.qt2_notes: Excluded from QT2. Critical final inspection for QT5 only.

quality_notes.QT5: Critical inspection under raking light. Satin/semi-gloss is less forgiving than flat.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Remove trim tape → Vacuum floors → Remove fixture protection → Clean tools → Final inspection.

round_configurations.name: Single Finish Coat
round_configurations.description: Standard single coat of wall finish paint. QT2 only.
round_configurations.notes: QT2 single coat economy finish. Minimal prep, no inspection/repair module.

round_configurations.name: Two Coat Finish (Standard)
round_configurations.description: Standard two coat wall finish. QT3 default.
round_configurations.notes: Two coats for uniform color depth and hide. No intercoat sanding at QT3.

round_configurations.name: Two Coat Finish (Premium)
round_configurations.description: Premium two coat wall finish with intercoat sanding. QT4/QT5.
round_configurations.notes: Two coats with light sand between. Critical for satin/semi-gloss finishes.

applicability_rules.description: QT2 is single coat only. No inspection/repair module, no intercoat sanding, no second coat.
QT3 defaults to two coats for uniform color depth. One coat acceptable if full coverage achieved (contractor discretion).
applicability_rules.coat_count_notes: Default 2 coats. 1 coat acceptable if full coverage achieved.

applicability_rules.description: QT4/QT5 requires two coats with intercoat sanding.
Spray and spray+backroll methods require wall fixture protection.
Floor protection inspection only when finished flooring exists.

assumptions.value: Wall finish spec owns trim masking task
assumptions.note: When painting finish on drywall walls, you always have to mask the trim. This spec owns that task.

assumptions.value: Wall painter establishes ceiling line via cut-in
assumptions.note: In NC production, ceiling painter rolled/sprayed freely past wall line. Wall painter creates the clean ceiling line.

assumptions.value: Opening cover lightweight NOT needed for wall finish
assumptions.note: Ceiling phase opening covers were removed before trim work. Trim masking (trim_edges zone) handles window/door adjacency protection.

uncertainties.description: Brief states wall height modifiers are 'less aggressive' than ceiling at 1.15/1.3/1.5. Modifier_Registry shows standard values 1.30/1.50/2.00. Using standard Modifier_Registry values pending doctrine update.
